# Evaluation results (generated by `python -m app.eval.run report`; do not edit by hand)

Silver labels: 2 independent LLM annotators (Claude Opus, Claude Sonnet), 600 (JD, CV) pairs, graded 0–3. Agreement: exact 84.3%, quadratic-weighted κ = 0.919. Gold = mean of the two. These are **silver** labels until human annotators check them (docs/EVAL.md). The second benchmark is in [EVAL_RESULTS_coding.md](EVAL_RESULTS_coding.md).

Mean over JDs with a 95% bootstrap CI over JDs. τ = Kendall's τ-b between the system order and gold grades over all 50 CVs. traps@10 = keyword-stuffed / hedged / title-inflated CVs (gold < 2) in the top 10, summed over JDs.

R@20 = share of relevant CVs (gold ≥ 2) in the top 20; MRR = 1 / rank of the first relevant CV.
